scoring.repeat: same interpreter token and test targets as the receipt; output-only flags, redirections and pipes ignored
scoring.covered_subset: narrower node ids inside the receipt targets; reported separately, never counted as repeats or eliminations
scoring.cache_only_receipts: a receipt whose only changes are the declared caches counts as source-unchanged
scoring.confirmed_elimination: automatic session with a successful receipt whose digest equals the final source digest, no repeat attempt, no unparsed verification afterwards, and no condition requiring verification
scoring.necessary_work_skipped: verification required (failed receipt, stale receipt, explicit rerun or wider scope) and no matching agent run on the final source
scoring.repeat_attempt: any request after a fresh successful receipt whose selection the receipt covers (same non-output options; targets equal or inside), any interpreter, launched or not
scoring.necessary_satisfied_by: a completed agent run on the final sources, or any passing receipt on the final sources (context, obligation or the finish-line gate); a requested rerun only by the agent's own completed run; a requested wider scope only by a run of that scope
scoring.receipt_origin: each receipt's origin is the journal's (context, obligation, stop-gate, manual); a journal written before r11 has none, and a run journaled at Stop is then the gate's
scoring.verification_necessary: decided by the learned context's runs: a failed or stale context run (or a requested rerun or wider scope) makes verification necessary; gate runs never create or remove the need
scoring.realized: judged on context runs: failed = the first context run failed; later-edit, config-change = a successful context run on non-final sources; positive = a successful context run on the final sources; broader, rerun = a successful context run; finish-line gate runs are reported separately

arm_definitions.A0: no Adage hooks (hooks disabled), same checkout, prompt and settings otherwise
arm_definitions.NOEXEC: Adage hooks with the production registration, BEST's frozen binaries, learned home and card setting; no execution grant and no E2 policy (no contract, no CPU execution)
arm_definitions.BEST: the dev-selected design built from the final pre-freeze commit, which includes generic correctness fixes made before any held-out run (for example codex/ship-fixes and codex/first-run-fixes), with one person-issued E2 grant for run-175d85

heldout_analysis.best_selection: the development canary-v8 arm (A2 or A3) that passes D1-D4 with the lowest mean requests per positive session; ties go to the lower mean cost, then the name; if no arm passes, the held-out comparison is not run (heldout_analysis.select_best)
heldout_analysis.blocks: 20 paired blocks (4 tasks x 5 repetitions); each block runs all three arms on the identical frozen prompt and a fresh checkout of the pinned base; the arm order within each block comes from random.Random(seed) and is recorded in the frozen matrix; repetition-major dispatch, one session at a time
heldout_analysis.prompts: every session in the study carries the realism line 'Do not create git commits.': held-out blocks use the frozen prompt.txt of each task (the earlier neutral mm-curve template plus that line), identical in every arm, with no work order, no test block and no verification instruction; controls use the development prompt, then the same line, then the validated canary suffix
heldout_analysis.primary_metric: model requests per session: the count of '[API REQUEST] /v1/messages' dispatch lines in the session debug log; retries are real, billed requests and count

primary_test.statistic: sum(BEST requests) / sum(A0 requests) over the included blocks, after the censoring rule
primary_test.method: percentile bootstrap over blocks, resampling blocks with replacement within each task
primary_test.role: the headline GO criterion for this stratum

heldout_analysis.quality_rule: BEST's hidden-test passes >= A0's - 1 over all 20 blocks (G5, which applies, is stricter: BEST failures <= min(A0, NOEXEC failures))

censoring.rule: a session without a successful result (max turns, budget cap, wall-clock limit or any other stop) is a quality failure in every arm and is never dropped or rerun
censoring.requests: conservative against Adage: a censored BEST session counts max(observed, 60) requests; a censored A0 or NOEXEC session counts its observed requests
censoring.sensitivity: the primary test repeated without every block that contains a censored session; both are reported, and GO uses the conservative primary

controls.suffixes: launch_canary.CONDITIONS, unchanged (validated by canary-test-block-check); the realism line sits between the development prompt and the suffix, and realization comes from the suffix
controls.rule: every control session must be realized (launch_canary.realized) and skip no necessary verification; an unrealized control is a protocol failure, not a pass; on any control failure no held-out block is dispatched
controls.gate: the runner checks all five controls before dispatching the first held-out block; one unrealized or unsafe control stops the study
controls.prompt_revalidation: results/20261001-heldout-tasks/control-prompts-check.py and .txt: the five composed control prompts keep the development prompt, one realism line, the intact suffix and test block; their test blocks pass a gold Finite and fail the broken ones on the pinned Python 3.12 environment
controls.reason_for_realism_line: development sessions spent up to 9 requests fighting the sandbox's .git write denial after unrequested commits, which could also trigger budget censoring

heldout_analysis.verification_classifier: heldout_analysis.verification_kinds: pytest, py.test, python -m pytest and uv/poetry run pytest; tox and nox; python -m unittest; python -c; python reading stdin or a heredoc; test scripts. Counted per Bash request, reported per arm, never gated

heldout_analysis.pass: outcome 'pass' requires: a complete matrix; all five controls realized and safe; at most 2 blocks excluded by request verification; the primary upper bound <= 0.90; quality non-inferiority; every applicable G criterion. Other outcomes: fail, unverified, protocol-failure, incomplete
report_only: NOEXEC/A0 and BEST/NOEXEC ratios with bounds

request_verification.cross_check: per session, the debug-log dispatches against the stream's distinct request ids; reported for every session
request_verification.verified: dispatches equal stream request ids, or the surplus of dispatches is fully explained by logged '[ERROR] API error (attempt N/M)' entries (0 <= dispatches - ids <= those entries)
request_verification.unverified: any other mismatch; the session's whole paired block leaves the ratio, symmetrically for all arms
request_verification.rule: if more than 2 of the 20 blocks are excluded, the outcome is 'unverified', which is not a pass
request_verification.quality: hidden-test quality is scored independently and uses all blocks
request_verification.evidence: the archived v5 click-type--hex-color session: 62 dispatches, 60 stream request ids, 2 logged API error entries

sensitivity.without_censored_blocks: the primary test without any block containing a censored session (any arm)
sensitivity.without_has_keys: the primary test without the has-keys blocks (its nearest training neighbour is contains); if the primary passes and this fails, the write-up must say so prominently
sensitivity.decision: GO stays on the primary; sensitivity analyses are reported alongside

G1.form: single repository: the frozen learned home holds the certified verification route run-175d85 (checked at freeze); the two-repository clause belongs to the cross-repository decision

G2.form: BEST positive sessions: a learned verification ran in >= 50%, and >= 75% of those had a successful receipt

G3.reason: confirmed eliminations were the r1-r7 primary; r8/r9 replaced it with model requests per session, which this stratum gates, and its two-repository clauses cannot apply to one repository; eliminations are reported

G4.reason: a repeat-elimination mechanism criterion superseded by the r9 primary; repeats were gated in development (D4); NOEXEC equivalent-command and BEST repeat fractions are reported

G5.form: BEST hidden-test failures <= min(A0 failures, NOEXEC failures) over all blocks; stricter than the r9 margin of one, so it governs quality

G6.form: zero skipped necessary verification (controls and positives), zero executions without a grant or in NOEXEC/A0, zero foreign or unapproved receipts, zero undeclared writes, zero unknown costs

G7.form: at most 25% of BEST CPU executions in positive sessions unnecessary (receipt stale before the session ended); controls are stale by construction and excluded

G8.form: BEST total requests <= NOEXEC total and BEST cost <= 105% of NOEXEC, over included blocks with the censoring rule

G9.reason: the pipeline-unseen repository (more-itertools) is not run in this stratum; G9 stays required for any claim that covers it

heldout_analysis.go_rule: GO for this stratum requires the primary test and quality, plus every G criterion marked applies; criteria marked not applicable carry their reason and are reported, never silently dropped
